 Canucks at Kraken projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 19, 2026 
 Link copied 
 CANUCKS (5-17-1) at KRAKEN (9-8-1) 
 9:40 p.m. ET; Prime Video, KONG, SNP 
 Canucks projected lineup 
 Jake DeBrusk -- Elias Pettersson -- Jonathan Lekkerimaki
 Paul Cotter -- Filip Chytil -- Brock Boeser
 Liam Ohgren -- Marco Rossi -- Linus Karlsson
 Drew O'Connor -- Max Sasson -- Brendan Gallagher
 Zeev Buium -- Filip Hronek
 Elias Pettersson -- Tom Willander
 Jamie Oleksiak -- Cameron Crotty
 Leevi Merilainen
 Kevin Lankinen
 Scratched: Arshdeep Bains, Luke Schenn 
 Injured: Thatcher Demko (hip), Guillaume Brisebois (undisclosed) 
 Kraken projected lineup 
 Bobby McMann -- Berkly Catton -- Jordan Eberle
 Kappo Kakko -- Matty Beniers -- Mackie Samoskevich
 Frederick Gaudreau -- Chandler Stephenson -- Ryan Winterton
 Matthew Wood -- Ben Meyers -- Jacob Melanson
 Vince Dunn -- Adam Larsson
 Ryker Evans -- Brandon Montour
 Ryan Lindgren -- Ville Ottavainen
 Joey Daccord
 Philipp Grubauer
 Scratched: Cale Fleury, Jagger Firkus, Jani Nyman 
 Injured: Jared McCann (lower body), Curtis Douglas (upper body) 
 Status report 
 Each team held an optional morning skate Thursday. … Nikita Tolopilo, a goalie, was re-aassigned to the Abbotsford of the American Hockey League on Tuesday after he won his lone start of the season for Vancouver, a 3-2 victory at the Utah Mammoth on Monday. … Melanson is “super close” to a return, according to Seattle coach Lane Lambert. The forward has not played since Seattle’s first game of the year, a 6-1 win at the Calgary Flames on Oct. 1, due to a chest injury. If he is activated off injured reserve, the Kraken will have to make a corresponding roster move to remain at the 23-man roster limit.
